messages:
Nina Patel: FYI customers on edge runtimes are hitting build failures after pulling latest SDK. Error is 'Cannot find module' during ESM resolution.
Omar Khan: Confirmed. npm package only contains dist/index.cjs and no index.mjs or index.d.ts. Package.json 'module' points to dist/index.mjs so ESM resolvers fail.
Violet Reyes: Also saw TypeScript errors for users: their projects can't find module '@redwood/inference' types because types field points to dist/index.d.ts which isn't published.
Nina Patel: Any idea how this slipped through? We have release checklist that used to run `npm pack` checks.
Omar Khan: Looks like a release script change last week. Build step sets format to 'cjs' by default and a conditional block that should copy .mjs/.d.ts was gated on an env var that CI no longer sets. So publish included only the CJS artifact.
Violet Reyes: Workarounds: pin to previous version or add a temporary resolution in package.json of consumer projects. Not acceptable long-term.
releaser-bot: release-bot: quick canary published as 0.9.4-canary.0 (private tag) after manual build with esm + cjs outputs. URL: https://npmjs.com/package/@redwood/inference/v/0.9.4-canary.0
Omar Khan: I'll validate by installing the canary into our edge smoke test (Cloudflare Workers + Vite). Also check that sourcemaps are included and map paths point to the original TS files, not the compiled tmp folder.
Nina Patel: Action items: 1) Fix CI env guard and make build emit both formats explicitly, 2) Ensure `declaration: true` and copy .d.ts to dist, 3) Add `npm pack` sanity check that asserts presence of index.mjs, index.cjs, index.d.ts and *.map files, 4) Add lightweight smoke test that imports the packed tarball in an ESM-only process.
Violet Reyes: I'll open the PR with the release-test script and update the release docs. Also adding note to changelog about the short lived breakage.
Omar Khan: After canary validation I'll cut stable patch 0.9.4 and update SDK samples/docs to reference the fixed version.
Nina Patel: Thanks. Keep this thread updated when stable publish is live so we can notify customers.
